subject.title: fix(slack): mark connected status degraded without bot identity

question: Have every Slack bot, user, and app-level token exposed during proof been revoked or rotated so this PR can safely proceed to merge review?
rationale: Repository code and CI cannot establish the external Slack credential state, and the contributor explicitly reports that real credentials were pasted during proof.

options.title: Require rotation confirmation
options.body: Keep merge paused until the credential owner confirms all exposed xoxb, xoxp, and xapp tokens were revoked or rotated, then refresh the head and rerun merge gates.

recommendation.title: Require rotation confirmation
recommendation.body: Keep merge paused until the credential owner confirms all exposed xoxb, xoxp, and xapp tokens were revoked or rotated, then refresh the head and rerun merge gates.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history shows the strongest connection to the Slack runtime and status boundary, making this the best available routing candidate for the pre-merge security confirmation.
